taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA FG1 | Female Genital Tract.

words.clue: Inflammation of the cervix caused by various infectious and non-infectious agents.
Obligate intracellular bacterium and most common STI-related cause of cervicitis globally.
Type of cervicitis featuring lymphoid follicles with germinal centers in the stroma.
Retention cysts of obstructed endocervical glands appearing as yellowish domes on the ectocervix.
Biological process in the transformation zone producing immature squamous cells vulnerable to infection.
Protozoon causing frothy malodorous discharge and strawberry appearance of the cervix.
Centers within lymphoid follicles in follicular cervicitis showing reactive immune response.
Smear preparation demonstrating multinucleated giant cells characteristic of HSV-2 infection.
Cellular infiltrate of lymphocytes and plasma cells that dominates in chronic cervicitis.
Columnar tissue lining the endocervical canal that is the primary target of gonorrhoeae.
Zone on the cervix where squamous metaplasia occurs and is preferentially infected by HPV.
